owner_objective: Final exact-head release audit of the completed 15-market Hixton candidate. Preserve the proven ten-coin Core, modular two-slot 50/50 sizing, and active NEAR/BCH idle-gap layer; keep SUI/UNI/AAVE research-only. Prove point-in-time/no-lookahead behavior, three-year backtest integrity, Backtest/Paper/Live/UI parity and fail-closed safety. Promotion to gpt/usdc-audit is allowed only after same-head A09 QA_PASS and A11 GOVERNANCE_PASS. Live entries remain disabled and no orders are sent.

acceptance.exact_head: Every A01-A11 report, integration artifact and UI/product parity result used for release must reference the same exact candidate commit.
acceptance.protected_core: The ten Core coin profiles and their priority semantics remain frozen during slot-layout comparison.
acceptance.slot_matrix: Compare 2x125, 3x~83.33, 4x62.50 and 5x50 at exactly 250 USDC total capital; include true 5x50 one_per_symbol and ranked_repeat variants.
acceptance.capital_scaling: Repeat candidate layouts at 1000 USDC using derived tranche sizes; fixed 125/50 product assumptions are a blocker.
acceptance.universe_matrix: Report Core10, Core+NEAR/BCH and Core+all-five so slot effects and Satellite effects are distinguishable.
acceptance.occupancy: Report zero/partial/full occupancy hours, utilization, NO_FREE_SLOT blocks, completed trades and slot trades.
acceptance.economics: Report baseline/stress PnL, return, drawdown, fees, holding time and per-symbol contribution; higher trade count alone cannot win.
acceptance.preemption: Core signals reclaim required Satellite slots at the next executable open; measure handoffs and Satellite preemption PnL.
acceptance.satellite_plan: NEAR and BCH are incumbents; AAVE gets the first bounded gap-filler refinement; SUI and UNI are redesigned for short gaps only after slot architecture is frozen.
acceptance.causal_separation: Do not alter slot layout and coin parameters in the same causal experiment.
acceptance.holdout_integrity: Training may select; validation/full evidence may reject but not invent a new candidate.
acceptance.paper_live_parity: A03/A06 identify any mismatch between research router and Paper/Live semantics before promotion.
acceptance.exchange_minimums: A07 verifies 50-USDC and scaled tranches satisfy current Binance USDC filters for all 15 targets.
acceptance.qa: A09 requires fresh exact-head static/tests/backtest evidence and rejects stale/mixed runs.
acceptance.governance: A11 requires fresh QA_PASS and complete A01-A10 evidence; no promotion or live activation in this round.
acceptance.release_candidate: Fresh integration, full regression, UI/browser bundle and agent evidence must all pass on the exact pinned release head.
acceptance.future_safety: Runtime decisions use closed-bar information only and execute at the next available open; holdout/future results cannot steer live decisions.
acceptance.product_shape: Ten Core coins remain primary; only NEAR/BCH may allocate Satellite capital and only while the Core is completely idle; SUI/UNI/AAVE are research-only.
acceptance.capital_modularity: Configured max capital X always derives two equal 50-percent slots; no fixed 125/50 sizing is permitted in product logic.
acceptance.live_safety: No API credential change, no testnet order, no real-money order and no automatic Live arming.
acceptance.promotion: Same-head A09 QA_PASS plus A11 GOVERNANCE_PASS authorizes code promotion to gpt/usdc-audit only. Live activation remains prohibited.

A01.objective: Audit requirements, causal separation, 15-market universe, active-vs-research Satellite distinction and experiment ledger. Flag contradictions.

A02.objective: Own exact-three-year 250/1000 slot-layout matrix and economic comparison across Core10, validated NEAR+BCH and all-five universes.

A03.objective: Verify Backtest/Paper/Live capital-plan and 15-market parity; identify fixed-notional or missing Satellite-preemption semantics.

A04.objective: Verify research layouts/inactive Satellites do not leak into normal product/UI as active claims.

A05.objective: Quantify liveness, idle/full/partial slot time, long-hold saturation and opportunity loss by layout.

A06.objective: Regression-test router allocator parameterization and prove omitted parameter preserves incumbent ranked_repeat behavior; check 15-market integration side effects.

A07.objective: Verify public Binance USDC filters/minimums for all 15 targets at 50-USDC tranche and scaled candidate tranches.

A08.objective: Assess concentration/drawdown/preemption risk and recommend slot architecture. Then review NEAR,BCH,AAVE,SUI,UNI contribution and bounded next gap-filler hypotheses.

A09.objective: Independently QA the exact candidate commit and reject decisions based only on trade count/headline return or stale evidence.

A10.objective: Synthesize A01-A08 into one slot-layout recommendation and named repair/search routes. Do not promote.

A11.objective: Govern the research conclusion on exact-head evidence only; require fresh QA_PASS and reject promotion/live activation.

dispatch_note: Final release round after taskboard alignment. Pin exact current HEAD; discard all earlier candidate-swarm rounds. Promote code only after same-head A09/A11; do not arm Live.
